question: Which Union Minister of Government of India inaugurated the 'India Chem 2022', in November 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mansukh Mandaviya.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mansukh Mandaviya **is the Union Minister of State for Chemicals and Fertilizers in the Government of India.
 
• **He inaugurated the 'India Chem 2022' event in November 2022.**
 
• **'India Chem' is a biennial event organized by the Department of Chemicals and Petrochemicals, Government of India, with the support of the Federation of Indian Chambers of Commerce and Industry (FICCI).**
 
• The event showcases the potential of the **Indian chemical and petrochemical industry** and provides a platform for industry stakeholders to network and explore business opportunities.
 
• Mansukh Mandaviya has been instrumental in launching various initiatives to promote the Indian chemical industry, such as the** 'Pharma Jan Samadhan' **portal and the** 'Ujjwala Urea' **scheme.
 
• He has also been actively involved in promoting the **use of biofuels** and reducing the **carbon footprint** of the chemical industry.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rajnath Singh** is the **Union Minister of Defence.**

 
 
• **​He has been associated with the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) since 1984 and has held various positions in the party and the government, including Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh and President of BJP.**
 
• He has also served as the Union Minister of Home Affairs and Transport.
 
 
 
• **Kiren Rijiju is the Union Minister of Law and Justice.**
 
 
• He is a member of the **BJP** and has been associated with the party since his college days.
 
• **He has been a Member of Parliament from Arunachal Pradesh and has held various positions in the party and the government, including Minister of State for Home Affairs and Youth Affairs and Sports.**
 
 
 
• **Rajeev Chandrashekhar **is the Union Minister of State for Skill Development and Entrepreneurship.
 
 
• He is a member of the BJP and has been associated with the party since** 2006.**
 
• **He has been a Member of Parliament from Karnataka and has been actively involved in promoting entrepreneurship and startups in India.**
